name: Higgsfield AI
tagline: Higgsfield AI is a video generation platform that gives users more control over generated footage than most competitors. You specify camera movements, character behavior, and cinematic style rather than hoping a prompt lands right. Content creators who need consistent output across a series of clips tend to find it more predictable than prompt-only tools.
